dataset.ground_truth_protocol: Generated from the same explicit synthetic values used to render each page; not independently adjudicated and not a holdout. Persian labels are Unicode source text, shaped only for raster display.
dataset.sampling_method: 64 deterministic one-page image-only machine-generated DDR fixtures in a balanced full factorial: 2 languages x 4 page layouts x 4 controlled scan conditions x 2 independent value sets per cell. Every language/layout/scan-condition combination is represented exactly twice. No field or vendor documents are sampled.

diagnostic.classification: synthetic development experiment; native-library emulator, not deployed CLI or holdout
diagnostic.method: one-to-one 80-percent smaller-box overlap; select whole mixed-script line when confidence exceeds Persian line by more than 0.05

limitations: All 64 pages are deterministic machine-generated synthetic English/Persian fixtures; none are sampled field or vendor DDRs.
Ground truth is generated from fixture fields, not independently adjudicated; metrics are development-only.
The cases cover printed text, four synthetic layouts and four controlled scan conditions; handwriting, real scanning pipelines and field variability are not represented.
CER/WER and fixture-token recovery do not establish semantic correctness, engineering acceptance, field performance, or production readiness.
No transcript, image, local path, uploaded data, provider request, or persistent output is included in this report.
reason: synthetic transcription metrics exceeded a global or stratified software threshold
